title: Saint Peter
alt: A man with light skin, white hair and a white beard, wearing an orange cloth over a dark-blue garment with gold embroidery, holds two large red keys in his left hand and a thin red cross-topped rod in his right, against a gold background within a patterned border.

title: The Veil of Veronica
alt: The pale face of a bearded man crowned with thorns, blood dripping down his forehead, floats against a white cloth hung over a wooden rod, which fills the painting against a black background.
